svg.title: Dynamic Bayesian decision network for the sugarcane grower
svg.desc: Two time slices, previous day (t) and current day (t+1). Observed weather and previous cane dryness determine cane dryness; cane dryness and current-day forecasts determine burning conditions; four-day forecasts determine advance burning requirements; the intention selection node chooses the amount of cane to burn, scored by the value of burning utility node together with grower size and current day burning requirements.
